info.name: Photo Editor
info.summary: Edit photos and open PSD files in Nextcloud
info.description:
A native Nextcloud app for editing raster photos and opening Photoshop PSD documents, built in the spirit of [PhotoCraft](https://github.com/storytold/photocraft) - an open-source, clean-room image editor.
**Supported formats:** PSD, PSB, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF, BMP
**Features:** - Open layered PSD and PSB documents and browse their layer tree - Composite the PSD layers to a preview using the document's own merge data, falling back to a faithful layer composite - Edit photos with crop, rotate, flip, resize and per-channel colour adjustments - Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, temperature and gamma with a live preview - Apply a filter pipeline (grayscale, sepia, invert, blur, sharpen, auto-contrast) without touching the original until you save - Undo and redo the full edit history - Save edits back to PNG, JPEG or WEBP, and export the current view - Preview thumbnails in the Files app, generated on demand - Start page with your recent images and a shortcut to open the Files app - Admin settings for theme, maximum file size, and previews - Dark and light themes, plus fullscreen mode - Responsive design that works on desktop and mobile
All rendering happens in the browser; the file never leaves the Nextcloud server except as the bytes the browser already has permission to read. See the [project README](https://github.com/ashcoft/nextcloud-photo-editor#readme) for requirements, installation and usage.
